description: This file defines the CheckedNumeric template class for safe arithmetic operations, including overflow detection, validation, and conversions, within the angle::base::internal namespace. It provides mechanisms for arithmetic with boundary checks, type conversions, and operator overloads, primarily used for robust numeric computations in Chromium-related code.

classes.name: CheckedNumeric
classes.description: A template class implementing safe numeric operations with boundary checks, validation, and conversions for arithmetic types.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the current numeric value is valid (no overflow or invalid conversion).

methods.name: ValueOrDie
methods.description: Returns the underlying value, crashing if invalid.

methods.name: ValueOrDefault
methods.description: Returns the current value or a default if invalid.

methods.name: ValueFloating
methods.description: Returns the floating point value, only for floating point types.

methods.name: validity
methods.description: Returns the current validity state of the numeric value.

methods.name: ValueUnsafe
methods.description: Returns the raw numeric value regardless of validity.
